recognize_zh: 周邊血中有四顆大型圓形母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻並可見核仁，細胞質中等量呈灰藍色、無顆粒；核常偏向一側、細胞質較多，符合單核母細胞（monoblast）。
features: Four large round blasts, about 2-2.5 times the diameter of red cells
Round, sometimes eccentric nuclei with fine lacy chromatin and one or more discernible nucleoli
Moderate rim of agranular gray-blue cytoplasm; no Auer rods
A small cell with a dense round nucleus to the right (small lymphocyte versus nucleated red cell) for size comparison
Red cells unremarkable; scattered platelets including a small clump; eyepiece photograph with modest resolution
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large circulating blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, discernible nucleoli and a moderate rim of agranular gray-blue cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not seen. A small cell with dense chromatin and scattered platelets are present for comparison. Lineage assignment requires cytochemistry (nonspecific esterase) or flow cytometry. Findings are consistent with circulating monoblasts of acute monoblastic leukemia (AML M5a).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation or without maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts usually have scantier cytoplasm and are MPO-positive or NSE-negative, whereas monoblasts are NSE-positive with CD14/CD64/CD11c by flow.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with a very high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm and express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers.
Megakaryoblasts may have cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61-positive rather than monocytic-marker positive.

ddx.dx: Large granular lymphocytes or reactive lymphocytes
ddx.vs: These have condensed chromatin without nucleoli and abundant pale cytoplasm often indented by adjacent red cells.
